record.summary: Passive.WATER_SPRING has no PassiveEffects entry. Instead each of MUDKIP, MARSHTOMP and SWAMPERT overrides beforeSimulationStart to add EffectEnum.WATER_SPRING to the opponent's effect set (the hook is called for every unit on a player's board, bench included, before entities are built). When the opponent's entities are added, applySynergyEffects runs every effect in the team set through applyEffect; the WATER_SPRING case adds the shared WaterSpringEffect (an OnAbilityCastEffect with origin Passive.WATER_SPRING) to every opposing unit's effectsSet. Afterwards, whenever one of those opposing units finishes castAbility (and was able to cast), the effect scans the board and for every unit with passive WATER_SPRING that is on a different team than the caster calls addPP(5, itself, 0, false) and broadcasts that unit's skill animation. The amount is the same for all three evolutions (stars do not scale it). The +5 is a requested amount: addPP rounds it, halves it under fatigue, and does not apply it at all when the receiver is silenced, protected (Rune Protect), has NO_PP_GAIN or is resurrecting; the result is clamped to 0..2 x maxPP - 1 (maxPP 60 here, so up to 119). Twist Band only changes negative values and Big Eater Belt is not used by addPP, so neither alters +5. Each cast of any opposing unit grants +5 to each Water Spring unit; two holders each gain separately, and the effect is added to the enemy team once per entity even if several Water Spring units exist.

conditions: Only casts by opposing units (team different from the Water Spring unit) count; the Water Spring unit's own and allies' casts do not.
The PP goes to every Water Spring unit on the board at that moment, not only the one that caused the flag.
The casting unit must have been able to cast (castAbility returns early otherwise).
